game_title: Flowchart Lab · Sum from 1 to n
game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the fire warden's power beats the shield shown by magma slimes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read n. Add all whole numbers from 1 through n, then display the total. For n = 0, display 0. Test dataset 5: {'n': 0}; {'n': 10}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the magma valve by solving code steps involving power that move the fire warden forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the magma valve first, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Comparison Duel – Ash Rim Trail Race
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
